faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Jammu is 30th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the IIT Jammu recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Tech./M.E. or B.Tech/B.E. in specific engineering streams with a minimum percentage and a valid GATE score, or an M.Sc. in Polymer Science/Materials Science with a valid GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 31,000/- plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Jammu JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Jammu is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: IIT Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 181221.
